rows.notes: [T103] NEW row from T100 lead. Solarbe 2025-08-28 (S1, fetched): the project's construction-works planning completion verification (竣工规划核实) is done and the plant is 'about to move from construction to production' -> physical works confirmed, production NOT confirmed -> under_construction (D-020; operational needs a source saying cells are in production; none found). Plan: 3 GWh/yr LFP energy-storage battery, total investment RMB 1.1bn, 101 mu, two phases (GWh split per phase not stated); phase 1 was scheduled for trial production Q1 2025 and formal production H1 2025 (S1c) - the article of Aug 2025 shows that schedule had slipped. Site plot: Suichang Economic Development Zone, Yanghao plot P(2022)30 (S1d). Capacity basis: 'can form 3 GWh/yr LFP energy-storage battery production capacity' (S1b); the page says 'battery', not 'cell', and gives no cell/pack split -> treated as cell capacity, flagged (D-026 not triggered because no pack/system bundling is stated). ref_year: fallback, searched (publication year 2025; no phase carries a 达产 year). Searched for later news (2 searches, 2026-11-24): nothing after 2025-08 found -> confidence 0.5, status may be stale (the plant may already be producing). RELATION TO EXISTING ROW yuheng-battery-yuheng-suichang-lishui-lithium-sodium-base-china (1 GWh filing, EnergyTrend, completion Dec 2027): same operator and same county; that 1 GWh item is a later filing for ADDED capacity and may be an expansion of this same plant rather than a second site. Plot of the 1 GWh item is not stated, so the two rows are kept separate and NOT summed by this patch; LEAD: decide whether to merge (if same site, nameplate would be 3 + 1 = 4 GWh). Coordinates not set (zone known, not geocoded).
